PRED-2026-09-22-PRESS-ACCESS.analyst_statement_verbatim: my prediction for this is that it will also not be fixed cheaply. and it most likely won't be fixed at all. leaving the space required for a purer propagandist state media to replace it. that combined with the media take over and mergers by the tech oligarchs could really distort any truth by never letting anything but lies be broadcast.

P1.claim: Not fixed cheaply. No credential restored by voluntary act before a court order.
P1.falsified_if: Any of the three outlets' credentials are restored without a court compelling it.

P2.claim: Not fixed in fact. By T+365 either no final appellate ruling restores access, or a ruling exists and independent TV-pool coverage of presidential events is still below its 2026-09-18 baseline.
P2.falsified_if: The five-network pool is back to its 2026-09-18 baseline under a complied-with court order.

P3.claim: Substitution, not vacuum. By T+365 the share of presidential-event footage originating from administration feeds or single-outlet friendly pools (Real America's Voice, OAN class) exceeds the share from the five-network pool, AND at least one of the state-imposed editorial boards at CNN or CBS has been altered, overridden, or allowed to lapse.
P3.falsified_if: The pool share recovers to majority, OR both editorial boards are intact and demonstrably exercised at T+365.
P3.note: The tech-oligarch consolidation claim is carried by the CNN/CBS board condition, the only part measurable on a one-year horizon. The rest stays in the annex as documented structure, not a scored claim.
